title: Rajasthan Man Kicks Woman Dancing At Event In Barmer, Crowd Watches In Silence: 'Arrest Him' | Video | Viral News - News18
text: An incident from Rajasthan has sparked widespread outrage after a video surfaced showing an elderly woman being kicked by a man while dancing during a public celebration. The clip captures the crowd watching silently as the woman is assaulted. The incident reportedly occurred near Sarla Sedwa police station in Barmer district. Many social media users have called the incident “shameful" and asked that action be taken against the man. What Happened In Barmer? The video shows an elderly woman dancing on the road while a DJ plays music. Suddenly, a man appears and kicks her from behind, causing her to fall. The crowd doesn’t interfere or come to the woman’s defence. The man and some of his friends start dancing, and one of them makes a shooing gesture towards the woman. The video was shared on X with the caption, “Has anything called “law" even survived in Rajasthan anymore..? A man openly kicks a woman dancing to DJ music in public, and everyone just stands there watching like it’s a spectacle @PoliceRajasthan take cognizance of the video, immediately arrest the accused and take strict action, Video is from Sarla Sedwa police station area of Barmer." What Did The Internet Say About The Incident? Several X users called for the man’s arrest. “Assaulting a woman in public is a crime, not tradition. Law must act fast, or silence will keep enabling this violence," a user wrote. “What can the law do to them anyway… the people standing right there should be the ones teaching them a lesson," another commented. “In RJ, is there even something called law or not? No matter whose government it is, the insult of women will not be tolerated," a person remarked. Talking about women’s safety in the state, one of them said, “Rajasthan is hell for women." What Did The Police Say? According to the Free Press Journal, police took swift action after the clip went viral and arrested the accused, identified as Deeparam. The police have stated that further investigation is underway in the matter. They assured that appropriate legal action will be taken against the accused. Authorities have asked the public to maintain peace and avoid glorifying violence of any kind.
summary: An incident from Rajasthan has sparked widespread outrage after a video surfaced showing an elderly woman being kicked by a man while dancing during a public celebration. The incident reportedly occurred near Sarla Sedwa police station in Barmer district. The video shows an elderly woman dancing on the road while a DJ plays music. A man openly kicks a woman dancing to DJ music in public, and everyone just stands there watching like it’s a spectacle @PoliceRajasthan take cognizance of the video, immediately arrest the accused and take strict action, Video is from Sarla Sedwa police station area of Barmer."
